effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 2 blue cards in your hand, unsuspend 1 of your Digimon and 1 of your [Kiyoshiro Higashimitarai], and this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card with [Jellymon] in its text is trashed from your hand, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
